summary: First iteration: Full backend (23 pytest cases) + comprehensive frontend Playwright tests on Hesab Salla accounting app. Backend 100% pass. Frontend critical flows (login, dashboard, RTL sidebar nav, settings save/persist, daily costs, Excel upload → analysis → result page with exports, history, reports) all working. Minor: logout redirect timing and recurring recharts width=-1 warnings.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking logout-btn, page did not visibly redirect to /login within 1.5s (URL stayed at /reports). Handler code calls navigate('/login') after logout(); likely a small awaitable race. Verify protected-route gate triggers on auth state change.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer prints recurring console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Likely missing minWidth/minHeight on parent. Cosmetic but spams console.

action_items: Investigate logout redirect: ensure clicking logout-btn reliably navigates to /login and ProtectedRoute kicks in immediately (probably small race or auth context state propagation).
Fix recharts ResponsiveContainer parent sizing (add explicit min-height or remove width/height=100% on flex containers) to silence width(-1)/height(-1) warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py set_auth_cookies hard-codes secure=True and samesite='none' — fine for HTTPS preview, but local dev over HTTP will silently drop cookies. The app mitigates by also returning access_token in JSON, so Bearer flow works.
server.py reads os.environ['MONGO_URL'] and ['DB_NAME'] at import (no get/default) — good fail-fast pattern.
JWT_SECRET is loaded inside get_jwt_secret() each call — fine.
/api/analyses POST uses query params for cost values instead of multipart form fields. Works but is non-idiomatic; consider Form(...) for cleaner OpenAPI.
Pydantic BaseModel uses model_dump() (v2) — confirmed correct.
Mongo _id excluded in all GET responses ✓.
Indexes created at startup (users.email unique, settings.user_id unique, daily_costs (user_id,date) unique) ✓.
Auth isolation verified by test — other user gets 404 on another user's analysis ✓.
seed_admin updates password if existing hash mismatches admin env password ✓ (playbook compliant).
bcrypt hash format $2b$ confirmed indirectly via successful verify_password cycle.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all primary flows pass; logout redirect timing only

test_credentials: admin@hesab.app / admin123 (seeded). Test user created on-the-fly per test run with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Each test session registers a fresh TEST_<uuid>@hesab.app user. Settings, daily-costs, and analyses are created and verified end-to-end. Frontend test also created daily cost (snap=77) and an analysis named 'salla_test.xlsx' for admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sample Excel at /tmp/salla_test.xlsx (10 orders, Arabic headers). Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — fully pytest-compliant, JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Login redirects to '/' (not '/dashboard') — use wait_for_selector('[data-testid="dashboard-page"]') instead of wait_for_url. All RTL nav items have data-testid (nav-dashboard, nav-upload, nav-history, nav-daily-costs, nav-reports, nav-settings). Analysis URL pattern is /analyses/{id}.
rca of the issue: No blocking RCA needed. Minor logout-redirect race likely caused by setUser(null) state update happening after the navigate() call resolves — verify AuthContext.logout() awaits state reset before resolving.
